Direct shear test on SS soil at relative density 0.30; apparatus: direct shear (Bendix Report No. MM-65-2). Recorded: peak shear stress vs normal stress.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 23 of the 25 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. Student reviewers have looked at 9 of the 25 points on the scan; none has yet been confirmed by two reviewers (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: specimen height, normal stress, held constant, displacement rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![maximum shear stress against normal stress, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-ds-fc-5a-dr30.png){.lightbox}

Peak maximum shear stress 142.5 kPa at 218.2 kPa normal stress; 142.1 kPa at 218.2 kPa, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-5a-dr30/observations.csv) (25 points: 5 plotted symbols, 19 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: maximum shear stress in Pa against normal stress in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-5a-dr30/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 450 Pa in normal stress, 1.1 kPa in maximum shear stress (0.8 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 23 of the 25 points; the other 2 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fc-5a).
